    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0])

code='''from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    marker=min(counts, key=counts.get)
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==marker]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    h=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; w=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(R-h+1):
      for c in range(C-w+1):
        if all(grid[r+dy][c+dx]==0 for dy,dx in shape):
          for dy,dx in shape: out[r+dy][c+dx]=marker
    return out
'''
